description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {C}{C}.
Elenda dies, triggering its second ability and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Elenda from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {C}{C}.
The Vampire dies, triggering Elenda's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Elenda.
Repeat.
